set.body: Phase 1 review finding 3 of 8. R/scope.R compile_lowering() trusts mutable S3 class tags and constructor-time checks. A constructed additive frame can be mutated to negative weights or fixed = FALSE and still collapse; factor-frame non-finite values can be admitted; sparse Matrix weights are rejected despite the intended searchlight representation. Revalidate all semantic invariants at compilation: representation, fixedness, finiteness, nonnegativity, dimensions, row mass or normalization policy, domain identity, and query operator shape and symmetry where required. Done when manually forged and post-construction-mutated objects fail closed and the intended sparse weight type has an explicit tested contract.
set.title: Make collapse admission fail closed at the compiler boundary
